Arista Networks (ANET) Holder De Burlo Group Decreased Holding by $5.92 Million as Shares Rose; Grassi Investment Management Has Lifted Its Visa Cl A (V) Position by $384,864 
April 17, 2018 - By Linda Rogers 
Grassi Investment Management increased its stake in Visa Inc Cl A (V) by 3.16% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Grassi Investment Management bought 3,376 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 110,233 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.57M, up from 106,857 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Grassi Investment Management who had been investing in Visa Inc Cl A for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $280.17B market cap company. The stock increased 1.85% or $2.26 during the last trading session, reaching $124.14. About 4.19 million shares traded. Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) has risen 31.98% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 20.43% the S&P500. 
De Burlo Group Inc decreased its stake in Arista Networks Inc (ANET) by 31.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. De Burlo Group Inc sold 25,200 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.25% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 54,270 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.78 million, down from 79,470 at the end of the previous reported quarter. De Burlo Group Inc who had been investing in Arista Networks Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $19.07 billion market cap company. (NYSE:ANET) has risen 91.94% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 80.39% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Mastercard Inc (NYSE:MA) by 91,700 shares in the quarter, for a total of 112,610 shares, and has risen its stake in Avery Dennison Corp (NYSE:AVY). 
Analysts await Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE:ANET) to report earnings on May, 3 after the close. They expect $1.32 earnings per share, up 67.09% or $0.53 from last year’s $0.79 per share. ANET’s profit will be $97.52M for 48.89 P/E if the $1.32 EPS becomes a reality.
